name: Dor'Danil Barrow Den
summary: In central Ashenvale, south of Splintertree Post, Dor'Danil Barrow Den lies under Forsaken shadow. Druids once slept here while their spirits roamed the Emerald Dream, but now the sanctuary is filled with horror.

sections.title: A Sanctuary Desecrated
sections.body: Night elven druids have slept for centuries in barrow dens across Kalimdor, their bodies sheltered underground as their spirits traveled the Emerald Dream. When the Horde pushed into Ashenvale, Dor'Danil lay deep behind enemy lines. The orcs mostly left the sleeping elves alone, but the newly allied Forsaken saw an opportunity. Their agents entered the depths and began experiments to sever the druids from their spirits. The ordeal fractured the dreamers' minds and drove them mad. Now sinister Forsaken assassins prowl the dark hollows, alongside the tormented spirits of druids who cannot return to their bodies.

sections.title: The Tormented Guardians
sections.body: Deep in Dor'Danil's tunnels, three druidic spirits wander in madness: Uthil Mooncall, Mavoris Cloudsbreak, and Taneel Darkwood. Darkslayer Mordenthal, a Forsaken agent, stalks the den as well. For night elves and their Cenarion Circle allies, laying the anguished spirits to rest is a grim mercy. The Forsaken presence also shows the ruthless, morbid curiosity Sylvanas's agents bring to Kalimdor's conflicts.

faq.answer: Dor'Danil Barrow Den lies underground in Ashenvale, south of Splintertree Post and southwest of Felfire Hill. Druids once slept here in deep trances, their bodies sheltered as their spirits entered the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why are the druid spirits inside hostile and insane?
faq.answer: Forsaken agents entered the den and experimented on the sleeping druids, severing their spirits from their bodies. The trauma left the druids violently insane.
Darkslayer Mordenthal is a Forsaken found deep in the barrow den among its undead occupants. His presence is known, but he is not identified as the experiments' director.

faq.q: Which notable spirits haunt the depths?
faq.answer: Three prominent druidic spirits haunt the lower chambers: Uthil Mooncall, Mavoris Cloudsbreak, and Taneel Darkwood. Severed from their bodies, they wander the dark tunnels in unending rage.

angles.text: As a druid, you know barrow dens as sacred places where druids commune with the Emerald Dream. The torture and fractured minds of those within Dor'Danil are an unforgivable sacrilege.
As an undead, you see Forsaken research in Dor'Danil as a relentless inquiry into life, death, and soul-severing magic, even on Kalimdor's distant battlefields.
